title: By-products
subtitle: Wool, dung and more — production, sales and own use

tracking.per_animal_hint: Quantity recorded per animal (e.g. wool at shearing). Each sale is shared out to the animals by what they gave, like milk.
tracking.farm_hint: No production records (e.g. dung). The sale is general farm income, not shared out to animals.

hint.period: Empty = everything recorded in the year before the sale.
hint.share: The full sale amount is shared out to the animals by the quantity each gave in this period.
hint.farm_income: This is general farm income — it is not shared out to animals.
hint.credit: The due amount goes to the buyer's balance; collect it from the customer page.
hint.credit_customer: Select the buyer when something is left unpaid
hint.partial_amount: Enter more than zero and less than the total
hint.no_per_animal: No per-animal product yet. Add one (e.g. wool) in Settings.
hint.no_species: No animal types are set for this product. Choose them in Settings.
hint.no_animals: No active animals of this product's species.
hint.empty_removes: Leaving a cell empty removes that animal's record for this date.
hint.stock_unit: Stock counts only sales and use in {{unit}}.
hint.in_use: In use — can only be turned off
hint.tracking_locked: Cannot change: it already has records or sales

confirm.delete_sale: Delete this sale? Its share in the animals' income is removed too.
